question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'rip and tear'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the third blank is** 'rip and tear'.**
 
• This option makes sense in the given context as it is discussing the color of the men's clothing fading due to the sun and rain, and the fabric being easily ripped and torn as a result.
 
• The other options do not make sense in this context as they involve actions that are not related to the fading of the color of the fabric.
 
• Let's see why other options are incorrect:
 
• **Option 1 - "Loosen and hang"** doesn't make sense in the given context, as it doesn't relate to the idea of clothes wearing out easily.
 
 
• Example: If a screw is not tightened properly, it may loosen and hang, causing the object to become unstable.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - "Crumple and crease"** may be an effect of wearing clothes, but it doesn't relate to the idea of clothes wearing out easily.
 
 
• Example: If a paper is folded, it may crumple and crease, making it difficult to read.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - "Cut and crack"** doesn't make sense in the given context, as it doesn't relate to the idea of clothes wearing out easily.
 
 
• Example: If a piece of wood is too dry, it may cut and crack easily when pressure is applied.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

There was a swagger (5)________ his steps.*
